rationale: Bounds immutable registry Git I/O in sparse partial clones and batches missing blobs so optional reuse falls back to fresh execution before the CI deadline. Product behavior, proof authority and release policy remain unchanged.

summary.ru: Проверка CI reuse пакетно читает недостающие Git-объекты и ограничивает ожидание, предотвращая отмену продуктового прогона.
summary.en: CI reuse batches missing Git objects and bounds lookup time to prevent product runs from being cancelled.
